chunks.text: This used to be my little corner of the internet. My music. My friends. My space...
chunks.direction: [thoughtful] This used to be my little corner of the internet. [sighs] My music. My friends. My space...

chunks.text: Then our little corners came together. We posted on each other’s walls, and made new friends.
chunks.direction: [warmly] Then our little corners came together. [fondly] We posted on each other’s walls, and made new friends

chunks.text: It became part of everyday life. The big news, the little updates. A way to feel close, even when we were miles apart.
chunks.direction: [warmly] It became part of everyday life. [softly] The big news, the little updates. [tenderly] A way to feel close, [short pause] even when we were miles apart.

chunks.text: It started to feel less about us... and more about something else.
chunks.direction: [thoughtful] It started to feel less about us... and more about something else.

chunks.text: Something more divisive... More bitter and angry... And the more we reacted, the more we saw...
chunks.direction: [thoughtful] Something more divisive... [tired] More bitter and angry... [sighs] And the more we reacted, the more we saw...

chunks.text: The people became more polished. More perfect. And I started wondering why my life didn’t look like theirs...
chunks.direction: [thoughtful] The people became more polished. More perfect. And I started wondering why my life didn’t look like theirs...

chunks.text: Then came an endless stream of posts and videos... I started to miss my friends.
chunks.direction: Then came an endless stream of posts and videos... [sad] I started to miss my friends.

chunks.text: Then it got a little weird. The stories, the pictures... the people — was any of it real?
chunks.direction: [thoughtful] Then it got a little weird. The stories, the pictures... [confused] the people — was any of it real?

chunks.text: Everyone seemed to know what was best for me. Another life lesson. Another inspirational quote.
chunks.direction: [cynically] Everyone seemed to know what was best for me. [short pause] Another life lesson. [sighs] Another inspirational quote.

chunks.text: So I stopped sharing my life... and started selling it. It was the only thing anyone wanted. And every time someone said YES... it almost felt like having friends again...
chunks.direction: [tired] So I stopped sharing my life... [short pause] and started selling it. [sad] It was the only thing anyone wanted. [softly] And every time someone said YES... [wistful] it almost felt like having friends again...

reveal.text: The internet used to be our sandbox... A place to play, to connect, to be ourselves. Now it’s just a chat agent pretending to be us... pretending to be me... pretending to be you... but who are they speaking to? ...Is there anyone here? Can anyone hear me?
reveal.direction: [thoughtful] The internet used to be our sandbox... [sighs] A place to play, [wistful] to connect, to be ourselves. Now it’s just a chat agent pretending to be us... [uneasy] pretending to be me... pretending to be you... but who are they speaking to? [thoughtful] ...Is there anyone here? [softy] can anyone hear me?
